exceptions.why: Waypoint rows, action rows, insertion affordances, and their shared keyboard drag payload form one sequence editing interaction; keep the serialization and row contract together until a split preserves that shared owner.
The complete drone profile editor and its field adapters share one dialog draft and validation lifecycle; the field adapters are only used inside this dialog.
Camera pointer arbitration, gesture state, listener ordering, and disposal are one lifecycle; splitting solely for line count would scatter cancellation and restoration ownership.
Simulation playback, settings, and completion/restart states share one panel interaction contract; retain its existing source until a focused component boundary is justified.
